mechanism.base: Water comes out of metal, as the old texts have it. The cold of the blade draws the damp from the air, and dew gathers along the steel where nothing was poured. The air gives up what it was holding. The hard thing gives the soft thing a surface to begin on, one clear drop at a time, and the whole tide below begins in drops this small.
mechanism.catalyst_turn: With too little Metal, less goes in than comes out. Nothing cold stands over the water, so no drop gathers and you answer on the spot. Take one thing in before you pass it on.
mechanism.friction_turn: With too much Metal, more settles in you than you pour out. The ore clouds the water it feeds, and each clear thought waits on one more check. Say one unfinished thing out loud.

function.definition_catalyst: Your Mind is where the world soaks in and becomes yours. Metal turns it exact, and what you take in is tested before it is kept. As a catalyst, little flows in from outside. What does reach you is held close and goes deep.
function.definition_friction: Your Mind is where the world soaks in and becomes yours. Metal makes it hard, keeping only what passed a test. As a friction, the test never ends. Nothing feels safe to you until it is right, and making sure eats the hours you meant for living.
function.definition_balanced: Your Mind is where the world soaks in and becomes yours. Metal turns it exact, and what you take in is tested before it is kept. In balance, the test is quick and fair. What passes it settles in, and you trust it enough to use it.
function.advise_catalyst: You let in less than the world has to offer, and the gap shows when a question needs more than you hold. Keep one book going that is harder than you need. Ask someone older how they did it, and hear them out to the end. Sleep on any answer that matters. Write the question down before you reply.
function.advise_friction: Seek Fire, the Action energy. Fire melts what has gone hard, so a checked thought becomes an act and the extra look burns off. Let it spend what Metal stores. Each extra round of care buys you safety and costs you a move. Ship one piece as a draft. Decide one small thing with no second look.

candidates.cta_verdict: You trust what you have tested rather than what you were told, so you learn slowly and keep it for good.

catalyst.clause: Nothing cold stands over the water, so no drop gathers
catalyst.remedy: Take one thing in before you pass it on.

friction.clause: The ore clouds the water it feeds
friction.remedy: Say one unfinished thing out loud.

wide.clause: You are well supplied with Metal, the cold surface the water gathers on.
wide.remedy: Use what has settled. Decide from it.

missing.clause: The water has no cold to gather on, and what you give out is never put back.
missing.remedy: Borrow it from someone who has already tested it.

spared.clause: No Metal over the water, and the water runs clearer for it.
spared.remedy: Keep it out. Act on what you already know.

thin.clause: Only a little Metal feeds the water, a thin cold that never clouds it.
thin.remedy: Leave it small. One check, then move.

excess.clause: Metal piled past use muddies what it feeds, and the current turns cloudy and slow.
excess.remedy: Pour something out, one decision and no more checking.

catalyst.clause: The cloud runs thin: intuition drawn on without refilling, feeling spent faster than it gathers.

friction.clause: The rigor sets like concrete: so much refining the rain never falls, feeling held in tanks of preparation.

wide.clause: You have plenty of Metal, the cold air that gathers the rain.
wide.remedy: Use the exact sources you already have.

mechanism_yin.base: Water is metal's child, the old reckoning says: dew beads on cold iron, molten metal runs like a river, and the exact hard thing releases the flowing one. So clarity feeds depth. What the whetted edge concentrates, the rain inherits, sharpness dissolved into drops and carried further than any blade could reach.
mechanism_yin.catalyst_turn: Run thin, the cloud runs thin: intuition drawn on without refilling, feeling spent faster than it gathers. Your chart asks for metal. Study something exact and drink from it.
mechanism_yin.friction_turn: Run heavy, the rigor sets like concrete: so much refining the rain never falls, feeling held in tanks of preparation. Pour something out. Rain proves itself by falling.

__ore.retired_fn_body: The Root is your learning function: the seat where the world soaks in and becomes yours. With Metal running it, your mind absorbs by distillation: exact teachers, clean sources, one precise sentence worth an hour of noise. What passes your filter condenses into permanent depth. Curate hard. Your intelligence is fed by quality, and clutter silts the spring.
__ore.retired_base_personal: Your core is Water, and Metal feeds Water: dew beads on the cold blade. Everything precise and refined that touches you, clear teaching, exact tools, people with standards, condenses into new depth. That is why Metal is your Mind, the intake that restores what flowing spends. Rivers are not fed by wishing. They are fed by cold clean edges upstream.

backlog_dips_tg_pattern.body: Ordered spaces and clean inputs are how your body refills its depth.

__ore.retired_v3_definition_catalyst:
Metal is your Mind, and as a catalyst, it is precision feeding your depth: exact teachers, rigorous methods, clean tools that turn vague knowing into usable clarity. You think better with structure than with more input.

Intuitive first, exact second, formidable when both. The notation learned properly, the method drilled until invisible, the one rigorous teacher: each has turned a year of vague sensing into something you can actually wield.

Structure is what makes your depth spendable. Learn one exact discipline properly, notation, code, a method, and let it organize everything else you know. Write definitions for the words you use most. Choose teachers stricter than your mood.
__ore.retired_v3_definition_friction:
Metal is your Mind, and as a friction, it is rigor calcifying: frameworks collected, systems perfected, understanding organized so thoroughly it never gets used. The structure is displacing the thinking.

A note system with better architecture than the ideas inside it. Templates for everything, tags on the tags, and the strange truth that the clearest thinking lately happened away from the entire apparatus.

Method is scaffolding, and scaffolding is meant to come down. Skip the new framework this month. Take what you already know and apply it somewhere messy. Once a week, think on paper with no system at all and see what you actually believe.
